A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same RL-PLUS paper, with 21 readable pages including Appendices A–E. Full-text comparison and rendered-page checks establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs visibly.

before.justification: v4 reports original benchmark experiments, component ablations, training dynamics, extended-training results, hyperparameter sensitivity and a case study in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v5 retains the same original empirical results, including Tables 1–4 and the training, sensitivity and case-study figures.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical multiple importance sampling, policy estimation, exploration-based advantage and composite objective definitions, including the removal of clipping. No algorithm component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: The OpenR1-Math training data, six reported math benchmarks and six programming/science OOD benchmarks are unchanged. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within every corresponding experiment, including LUFFY and ReLIFT in Table 1 and GRPO/SFT+GRPO in the Figure 7 case study.

E3.justification: Appendix E retains identical model configurations, training budgets, rollout counts, response limits and evaluation temperature of 0.6. The pass@k evaluations and Section 5 extended-training procedure also match.

E4.justification: The Table 4 component ablations, training-dynamics and stability analyses, pass@k comparisons, Appendix C hyperparameter sensitivity and Appendix D case study are identical.

E5.justification: Appendix E reports average pass@1 over five runs in both versions. There are no changes to run information, seeds, uncertainty reporting or statistical estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 retains average scores of 53.4 for RL-PLUS and 48.2 for SFT+GRPO; Table 2 retains 48.8 for RL-PLUS and 44.9 for GRPO.

T1.justification: Theorems 3.1–3.2 and Appendices A–B retain identical assumptions, definitions, bias/variance derivations, Bayesian estimation arguments and gradient-focusing proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about countering capability boundary collapse, benchmark performance, generalization and applicability across model families.

C2.justification: Interpretations of exploration and entropy, OOD generalization, training stability, hyperparameter choice and the case study are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: Appendix E retains the same implementation details, hardware, data processing and hyperparameters. Code and data access information is unchanged; the updated arXiv self-link only identifies the later paper version.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 and the reference list are identical. No cited works or substantive relationships to prior research change.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v4, 19 Oct 2025, to v5, 15 Apr 2026. This is a limited identification-text edit; the title, authors, prose, section order and appendices are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All seven figures, four tables, captions and page arrangements are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–21 are pixel-identical, and page 1 differs only in stamp text at the same margin position.

improvement.justification: The complete main text and appendices retain identical scientific content, empirical evidence, proofs and reproducibility information. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and associated self-link provides no meaningful overall quality gain or loss.
